title: Nintendo Was Founded Before the First Airplane Ever Flew

scenes.text: Nintendo is older than the airplane. By fourteen years.
It was founded in Kyoto, Japan, in eighteen eighty-nine. The Wright brothers didn't fly until nineteen oh three.
Back then, Nintendo made hanafuda, hand-painted Japanese playing cards, sold from a small shop.
It stayed a card company for most of a century, and didn't launch its first game console until nineteen seventy-seven.
It survived by pivoting, from cards to toys to electronics, always chasing whatever people played with.
Today, Nintendo is still based in Kyoto. Same company, same city, a hundred and thirty-seven years later. What's the oldest brand you use every day?

description:
Nintendo is older than the airplane, by fourteen years.
Fusajiro Yamauchi founded the company in Kyoto in 1889 to make hanafuda, traditional Japanese playing cards. In 1902 it produced Japan's first Western-style playing cards, and it did not release its first video game console until 1977.
The Wright brothers made their first flight in 1903.
What's the oldest brand you use every day?
